parsed.rationale: Both participating records live under test directories — `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsMarkupParserTests.swift` and `WXYC/iOS/Tests/WXYCTests/DiscogsFormatterTests.swift` — and the duplicated method belongs to a type named `MockDiscogsEntityResolver`, a clear mock fixture. Although the pipeline's context flags report `is_test: false` and `is_mock: false` for both records (suggesting a labelling gap in the analysis pipeline), the literal file paths and type name are unambiguous: these are test-only mock implementations of `resolveMaster` scoped to their respective test targets (`Metadata` and `app:iOS`). Consolidating them into shared production code would couple test-fixture semantics into a production or shared package, which is the canonical restraint pattern. The duplication is intentional: each test target needs its own local mock to remain independently compilable and to express test-local behaviour.
